compatibility.detail: The U.S. manual identifies robot V10VIV and Empty Wash Fill Dock EWFD26LRR. Match both labels; this guide's dock-bag advice is for the standard Empty Wash Fill Dock configuration.

compatibility.part: DuoDivide main brush and FlexiArm side brush
compatibility.detail: Qrevo Curv uses two short parallel DuoDivide rollers and an arc-shaped FlexiArm side brush. Check for these exact assemblies; a conventional Qrevo roller or brush cover is a different part.
The washable filter sits in the robot dustbin. The disposable bag sits inside the dock. They are separate consumables with different fit checks.
The standard Curv uses round spinning cloths. Roborock says its Curv cloth listing does not fit CurvX; Qrevo Curv 2 Flow uses a roller-mop system, so this cloth guide is not for that model.

careTip: Switch off the robot before servicing brushes or mop parts. Rinse the washable filter with clean water only and let it air-dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling.

questions.question: How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Curv?
questions.answer: The U.S. manual lists robot model V10VIV and Empty Wash Fill Dock model EWFD26LRR. Check both labels before choosing parts.

questions.question: Which main brush does the Qrevo Curv use?
questions.answer: It uses the DuoDivide assembly with two short parallel rollers and spiral blades. Choose a listing that names Qrevo Curv and shows the complete DuoDivide brush.

questions.question: Do Qrevo Curv mop pads fit CurvX?
questions.answer: Roborock explicitly says its Qrevo Curv and Edge round mop cloths are not compatible with CurvX. This guide's third-party cloth listing names standard Qrevo Curv; verify your exact model before ordering.

questions.question: Are these all genuine Roborock parts?
questions.answer: The linked DuoDivide brush, side brushes and washable filters are Roborock-branded. The mop cloths and dock bags are third-party items; DustMigo has not physically tested their fit or durability.

questions.question: How often should I replace Qrevo Curv filters and brushes?
questions.answer: Roborock recommends replacing the main brushes and washable filter every 6–12 months and the side brush every 3–6 months. Clean the main brushes and filter every 2 weeks, and clean the side brush monthly.
